verses.t: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment
verses.pickthall: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them

verses.t: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner
verses.pickthall: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you

verses.t: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me
verses.pickthall: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me

verses.t: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew
verses.pickthall: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew

verses.t: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day
verses.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day

verses.t: But my invitation increased them not except in flight
verses.pickthall: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance

verses.t: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance
verses.pickthall: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride

verses.t: Then I invited them publicly
verses.pickthall: And lo! I have called unto them aloud

verses.t: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
verses.pickthall: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private

verses.t: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver
verses.pickthall: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving

verses.t: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
verses.pickthall: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain

verses.t: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers
verses.pickthall: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers

verses.t: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
verses.pickthall: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity

verses.t: While He has created you in stages
verses.pickthall: When He created you by (divers) stages

verses.t: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
verses.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony

verses.t: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp
verses.pickthall: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp

verses.t: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth
verses.pickthall: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth

verses.t: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction
verses.pickthall: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing

verses.t: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
verses.pickthall: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you

verses.t: That you may follow therein roads of passage
verses.pickthall: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof

verses.t: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss
verses.pickthall: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin

verses.t: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
verses.pickthall: And they have plotted a mighty plot

verses.t: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr
verses.pickthall: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

verses.t: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error
verses.pickthall: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error

verses.t: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers
verses.pickthall: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah

verses.t: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant
verses.pickthall: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land

verses.t: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever
verses.pickthall: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates

verses.t: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction
verses.pickthall: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin
